text: なにか　りょうりを　つくったあと　みたい！

structure.jp: なにか　りょうりを　つくったあと
structure.en: the aftermath of having cooked something

patterns.name: 〜みたい
patterns.span: つくったあと　みたい
patterns.explanation: みたい at the end says 'it looks like', a guess from what you see. つくったあと　みたい = 'it looks like the aftermath of cooking'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: りょうりを　つくったあと
patterns.explanation: A past verb placed right before あと tells you what happened before it. りょうりを　つくったあと = 'after having made a dish'.
